question: A group of 36 students has an average present age of 14 years. When the age of the teacher is included, the average age rises by one. Calculate the teacher's age (in years).
solution:
**GIVEN:**

 Average of age of 36 students = 14 years

Average of teacher and students = 15 years

**FORMULA USED:**

Average = sum of values/ number of values

**CALCULATION:**

⇒ Sum of students / 36 = 14 

⇒ sum of age of students = ( 36 × 14 ) = 504.

⇒ ( sum of students + teacher) /37 = 15

⇒ sum of age of students and teacher = ( 37× 15) = 555

⇒ Age of teacher = ( sum of age of students and teacher) - sum of age of student = (555- 504) = 51 years.

**Hence, the teacher is 51 year old.**
